import json,re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/COSTCO_2017_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
for i,el in enumerate(data.get('texts',[])[:80]):
    t=el.get('text','')
    if re.search(r'telephone|phone|registrant|costco|washington', t, re.I):
        print(i, el.get('page_no'), repr(t[:300]))
PY"
